video_title: Wemby Gets A Shohei Ohtani Deal from Spurs???

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's unique playing style and impact on the game
quotes.excerpt: the Wemby variance is one of the wildest things that I've seen on this stage
quotes.quote: The Wemby variance is one of the wildest things that I've seen on this stage. These types of games in terms of, I mean, game one I tried to write, it's some hybrid of Wilt and Russell and Steph all combined in one, just incredible basketball. And then game three, all of a sudden, I think at 41 rebounds in the first two games and then four in the third and then he kind of fell off from there. And so going into game six, as far as takeaways, I thought the Thunder had control of this thing. I actually thought they were going to finish the job, but you still wondered, can Wemby muster something up again? And obviously he did.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: How teams are building rosters to counter Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: it's loading up on bigs. It's not like the Shaq old days when you just needed as much heft
quotes.quote: We've seen this before in terms of the impact on how teams build their rosters. It's a copycat league. So when the Thunder and the Pacers get to the finals with rosters that go 12 deep, everybody started pivoting and trying to get as deep as possible. But now the Wemby effect is, I actually think it has a domino effect on the Giannis sweepstakes this summer, where there's only so many guys in the league that can give you a puncher's chance at slowing Wemby down. Look at the Thunder. They got a guy in Chet Holmgren who at first glance looks like Taylor-made to give him some pushback. The impact is, even beyond getting a guy like that, it's loading up on bigs. It's not like the Shaq old days when you just needed as much heft as possible. You got to have guys who can play three, four positions and be versatile and keep up with this 7-4 alien.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: The potential for massive future contracts for Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: he's brought in so much revenue for the league that you look at it and even in the here
quotes.quote: We used to talk about this with LeBron. He's brought in so much revenue for the league that you look at it and even in the here and the now, as he hits free agency, no wonder he's not looking to take a pay cut because that guy's been generating revenue for a long time. With Wemby, I don't know what the number is, but as you know, things have changed. Even today, story coming out about Luka being a part owner in a league overseas, guys want a stake. I don't know if the CBA is ever going to change to reflect true value, but for Wemby to be doing this this early and to be taking the game to another level globally where you're going to have potentially a face of the league coming from France, but being the type of personality that can resonate with people of all cultures, I think the money is just going to get printed and he's probably going to be underpaid for most of his career.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's media availability and accountability after losses
quotes.excerpt: accountability matters. And when Tim Duncan would never talk to the media, he would always talk to the media
quotes.quote: It's not about us. It was a bad look because as a player, accountability matters. And when Tim Duncan would never talk to the media, he would always talk to the media when they lost, because he didn't want his teammates having to sit there and answer questions that he thought that he should be answering. With Victor, he's barely done this sort of thing over his first three years. It was definitely a break from his norm. The people I talked to basically said like he was not only pissed, but just it was a philosophical thing about I don't care about anything else other than answering the call after I had a bad game five and of course the whole season was on the line. So to his credit, if they lost last night and if he laid another egg, then he would have been looking at three months of ridicule when it comes to the fans and social media.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox's future with the Sacramento Kings
quotes.excerpt: it's basically a backhanded compliment to Dylan Harper. It's not meant to disparage De'Aaron
quotes.quote: It's something that people around the league have certainly talked about all season and it's basically a backhanded compliment to Dylan Harper. It's not meant to disparage De'Aaron, but it's like damn, Dylan is so good, how long until he gets his time? What I was trying to convey in that story is that like always, it's one thing for people around the league to connect these dots and predict that certain things are going to happen, but I do enjoy trying to get on the ground and talk to the people who are actually involved and find out if that is the case. And for now, that is not the way the Spurs discussed De'Aaron. They're thrilled for him that after his Sacramento experience when he had so many coaches and turnover and no stability, they're thrilled that he can unpack his bags and be an important part of their program.
